episodes.title: ¿Te acuerdas de Curro?
episodes.summary: When Amparo's husband is killed in a massive explosion, a strange figurine suggests it wasn't an accident — so she turns to a haunted ex-cop for help.

episodes.title: La España que nos dejaron
episodes.summary: Frustrated by police inaction, Amparo travels alone to Seville, where a stranger warns her to stay away and the killer prepares to strike again.

episodes.title: Sevilla es como soñar con el cielo
episodes.summary: Amparo unravels a 30-year-old blackmail fiasco, revealing a darker side to the Expo. Joined by Richi and Robledo, she searches old archives for clues.

episodes.title: Mirando al abismo
episodes.summary: As the explosion harms an unintended victim, Richi and Amparo track down a key player from the Expo, while Robledo teams up with a forensic investigator.

episodes.title: Eran otros tiempos
episodes.summary: Reeling from yet another tragedy, Amparo and Carmen join forces and look into Rosa's past. A shaken Richi stumbles upon a vital piece of information.

episodes.title: Hice lo que me pidieron
episodes.summary: Palacios attempts to buy his safety, but as the killer's bloody vendetta reaches its crescendo, the race to stop him takes a high-speed turn.
